title: Compiled Context Record
description: Post-RAG compilation-stage knowledge record. Replaces raw chunk retrieval with pre-synthesized citation-linked agent-ready knowledge artifacts that carry provenance confidence and temporal validity.

contextId.description: Unique ID for this compiled context unit

version.description: Monotonically increasing version — recompilation bumps this

domain.description: Knowledge domain for routing and access control

synthesizedText.description: The pre-compiled dense knowledge synthesis. This is what agents consume directly — no further RAG retrieval needed at inference time.

pointerId.description: Reference to the RAG_PROXY_POINTER record that sourced this

sourceUri.description: Canonical URI to the raw document

relevance.description: How much this source contributed to the synthesis

excerpt.description: Key excerpt from the source used during compilation

confidence.description: Model confidence in the synthesis quality

validUntil.description: Temporal validity — after this date the context should be recompiled

dependencies.description: Other CompiledContext records this one depends on

agents.description: Agent IDs authorized to consume this context
